meta.name: Mithya
meta.description: A tale of two women who are at odds with each other over allegations of plagiarism, which sparks a series of hostilities and shocking revelations spun around a murder for which they both are suspects.

videos.title: Maine Dekhi Hai Uski Mrityu
videos.overview: Juhi, Rhea's Hindi literature professor, suspects her of cheating in her term essay and fails her. Later, Rhea manipulates Arun, the hostel security guard, to get Juhi’s address.

videos.title: Nishaane Pe Sirf Main Thi
videos.overview: Juhi and Neil’s relationship begins to fall through the cracks. Juhi and Rhea's rivalry becomes public after she deliberately humiliates Rhea in class. Rhea visits Juhi's house and meets Neil.

videos.title: Sach Ke Kai Pehlu
videos.overview: Juhi becomes increasingly suspicious about Rhea after she loses her wedding ring. She notices Rhea wearing her wedding ring and attacks her at the founder's day party. Neil and Juhi have a huge fight.

videos.title: Sach Ki Tarah Log Bhi Complex Hote Hain
videos.overview: Juhi goes through emotional turmoil and seeks support from her parents. Anand pays a visit to Rhea. Rhea seduces Neil while Juhi is at her parents' anniversary party.

videos.title: Hum Sab Mein Ek Cheat Hota Hai
videos.overview: Neil shows Juhi the picture he found in his pocket. Juhi confronts Anand about the picture and he confesses the truth about Rhea. Rhea reveals her past to Neil. Juhi returns home to a shocking sight.

videos.title: Tum Phool Si, Main Kaante Si
videos.overview: Sunanda is convinced that there is more to the story and digs deeper into Rhea's life. Anand manages to get Rhea to confess her crime. Rhea attempts to reach out to Juhi, but her hopes are shattered.

videos.title: Chehre Pe Chehra
videos.overview: Juhi is accused of plagiarism by Amit Chaudhary. She suspects Rhea to be behind the allegation. Meanwhile, Rhea’s plan to inherit the Rajguru estate is at risk. A shocking revelation awaits Anand.

videos.title: We Are Family
videos.overview: Amit serves a legal notice to Juhi through Anand. Anand’s attempt to meet Amit and resolve the matter only complicates it further. On the other hand, Rhea learns about Juhi’s past with Vishal.

videos.title: The Darkest Hour
videos.overview: Juhi learns about Anand’s confession of plagiarising from Amit and publicly takes the blame to protect Anand. A guilt-ridden Anand apologizes to Juhi and Rhea before taking a drastic step.

videos.title: I Will Never Stop
videos.overview: Juhi tries to find the truth behind the plagiarism allegations. Meanwhile, Rhea searches for Yash's real father. When Yash goes missing, Juhi suspects Rhea and takes the police to the Rajguru estate.

videos.title: Jo Karna Tha, Mujhe Karna Tha
videos.overview: Arun's obsession endangers Yash, forcing Rhea and Amit to fight him. Juhi gets admitted to a mental facility after hearing of Yash's death. Amit becomes fearful of Rhea's ambitions.

videos.title: Tum Aur Main Alag Nahi
videos.overview: Amit tells Juhi that Yash is alive and with Rhea. Juhi tricks Rhea to continue her search for Yash at the Rajguru estate. A final confrontation with Rhea forces Juhi to turn the tables.
